details:
[Bug] Nameplate Floating Extremely High Above Avatar – Persists Across All Avatars and Desktop Mode

-Description-

My nameplate is consistently displayed far above my avatar's head instead of its normal position.

This issue occurs regardless of which avatar I use, including public avatars, sample avatars, and the default robot avatar.

Other players have confirmed that my nameplate is also positioned abnormally high from their perspective.

The issue persists in both VR Mode and Desktop Mode.

-Steps to Reproduce-

1. Log into VRChat with my account.

2. Select any avatar, including the default robot avatar.

3. Enter a world in either VR Mode or Desktop Mode.

4. Observe that my nameplate is floating far above my avatar's head.

5. Other players can also observe the incorrect nameplate position.

-Expected Behavior-

The nameplate should appear at the normal height directly above the avatar's head.

-Actual Behavior-

The nameplate appears abnormally high above the avatar, regardless of the avatar used or the game mode.

-Troubleshooting Already Attempted-

- Tested multiple public and sample avatars.

- Tested with the default robot avatar.

- Cleared the avatar cache.

- Completely reinstalled VRChat.

- Tested in Desktop Mode.

- Changed the "Real User Height" setting to extreme values and restored it to force resynchronization.

- Used the "Reset to Default Avatar" option on the VRChat website.

- Asked other players to confirm the issue from their perspective.

None of these steps resolved the issue.

-Additional Information-

Since this issue persists even with the default robot avatar in Desktop Mode, it does not appear to be caused by a specific custom avatar or Unity configuration.

I suspect that this may be an account-specific issue, potentially related to stored avatar height or scale data, although the root cause is currently unknown.

I have already contacted VRChat Support and was directed to submit a bug report here.

I would appreciate it if the development team could investigate this issue.

Thank you.
title: [Bug] Nameplate Floating Extremely High Above Avatar – Persists Across All Avatars and Desktop Mode
